author: Inside Edition
description: There continues to be anger at Cornell University over the alleged drugging and gang rape of a female student by seven fraternity brothers. Now, just-obtained texts between the alleged victim and one of the frat brothers reportedly reveals him apologizing for "how things went down" and saying  things got "way out of hand." None of the frat brothers have been criminally charged Inside Edition's Justin Finch is in Ithaca, New York with the latest.
title: Shocking Texts In Cornell Case Revealed

author: Inside Edition
description: A man was found shot to death in a parking lot and police say his wife's elderly parents have been arrested. Dublin Police Services in California say the body of Jonathan McKinsey, 40, was discovered by a passing officer in the parking lot of a sports and park complex. Shouyong Zhang and Shili Chen, both in their 70s, have been charged with murder, authorities say. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Elderly Couple Allegedly Shoots Son-in-Law to Death At Park

author: Inside Edition
description: In 1995, when Christa Pike was 18 years old, she murdered fellow student Colleen Slemmer with a box cutter. Tomorrow, Pike is scheduled to be executed by lethal injection in Tennessee. She would be the first woman executed in the state in more than 200 years. Pike has one last request: to be put to death by an all-female execution team. Inside Edition's Steven Fabian reports.
title: Christa Pike Has One Last Request Before Execution By Lethal Injection

author: Inside Edition
description: The son of late "Superman" star Christopher Reeve made a stunning announcement on air today. Will Reeve, a correspondent with ABC News, appeared on "Good Morning America" to reveal he was diagnosed with testicular cancer months after his wedding . Reeve's wife was by his side as he shared that the cancer had spread to his lymph nodes. The 34-year-old newsman discussed the treatment he'd already undergone, including an orchiectomy.
title: Will Reeve, Son Of ‘Superman’ Star, Announces He Has Cancer

author: Inside Edition
description: Lindsay Clancy was back in court for the first time since her Massachusetts murder trial ended in a mistrial earlier this month. Her lawyer dropped a bombshell, claiming Clancy's murder charges should be dismissed because there was not enough evidence to convict her, he alleged. Inside Edition's Ann Mercogliano reports.
title: Lindsay Clancy Back In Court For First Time Since Mistrial

author: Inside Edition
description: A concerned citizen called in suspicious activity to police and when the suspect was found, cops say he tried to outrun them at eight miles per hour. The Upland Police Department in California says an officer tried to stop the man on a bike, who was suspected of stealing mail from neighborhood homes. They say instead of stopping, he tried to make a break for freedom. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Suspected Mail Thief Riding A Bike Tries To Outrun Police Car, Gets Arrested

author: Inside Edition
description: Has foodie culture gone too far? Not for people who lined up outside a bakery in New York’s upscale SoHo neighborhood, prepared to spend $60 on a loaf of rye bread. How does one justify charging $60 for something simply made from rye flour, water and salt? This is New York, afterall, where time is money. Owners say it takes 24 hours to ferment the dough and then another eight hours for the bread to rest after it's baked. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: These People Lined Up To Pay $60 For A Loaf Of Rye Bread In NYC

author: Inside Edition
description: Dennis Haskins has died according to his agent. He's best known as Bayside High principal, Richard Belding, on the hit show 'Saved by the Bell.' The show ran from 1989 until 1993, but was reprised as 'Saved by the Bell: The New Class' from 1993 until 2000. While he made appearances in other shows throughout his career, his most prominent role was the tough-loving Mr. Belding, always interrupting student antics with his famous catchphrase. He was 75.
title: Dennis Haskins Who Played Mr. Belding On 'Saved By The Bell' Dies At 75
